items.title: O-florens rosa (Frye)
items.desc: Walter Frye, O-florens rosa. 3 voices (Discantus, Tenor, Contratenor), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Fry2002); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.

subs.note: Chansons and other songs, in all their voices.
